messages:
maria: spotted issue on mobile: progress strip compresses to icons and loses labels, SR users can't discover counts. anyone else see this?

sam: yep, code hides text nodes with display:none at <480px. easy fix: visually hide but keep for SRs.

olivia: use .sr-only instead of display:none and add aria-labels like '3 checks passed'. also aria-live='polite' for updates.

jeff: design: move strip inline under step heading on small screens to keep logical flow?

maria: yes, inline under heading keeps tab order stable.

kyle: also don't rely on color alone. include text or shape. alt text for icons.

sam: implementation note: update counts in-place (no re-creating nodes) and debounce updates 200ms to avoid SR chatter. backend SSE includes summary payload.

qa-bot: add Cypress test for mobile breakpoint + axe scan for progress strip and the details sheet.

olivia: mobile sheet for probe details traps VoiceOver. add aria-modal, inert background, and a clear Close control top-left.

maria: action items: i'll update Figma mobile frames. sam will change CSS to sr-only + in-place updates. olivia will draft aria snippets. jeff pick shortcut key to jump to strip and update keyboard help. kyle update icon copy. qa-bot will add tests.

jeff: picking 'g' for "go to summary". we'll validate in tomorrow's QA session. :+1:
